insights.title: Forecast ↓ — Expect App Total Revenue to soften next period — App Total New Subs -21.4%, led by YCP.
insights.body: App Total New Subs -21.4% runs well below its upstream (App Total New User -9.4%, App Total Install +2.5%; Δ -17.9pp). With the 7-day trial lag, expect App Total Revenue to soften next period. The drag is concentrated in YCP (-25.3%); YCV is -15.3%.

insights.title: Lead–lag check — App Total Revenue is tracking its subs signal as expected.
insights.body: App Total Revenue 07-25 vs 07-18 = -1.3% tracks its 7-day driver App Total New Subs 07-18 vs 07-11 = -2.2% — revenue is following the subs signal as expected.

insights.title: Funnel conversion — Conversion to New Subs splits by app — YMK softening (-18.7% vs upstream -1.6%).
insights.body: Upstream→New Subs conversion splits by app: YMK -18.7% vs upstream -1.6% (conversion softening); YCV -15.3% vs upstream +4.6% (conversion softening). (Revenue is downstream and lags ~7d — see the lead–lag check.)

insights.title: App split — App Total New User -9.4% concentrated in YCP — not platform-wide.
insights.body: App Total New User -9.4% is uneven by app (All App -9.4%, YMK -10.3%, YCP -11.0%, YCV +4.9%) — driven mainly by YCP, not a platform-wide shift.

insights.title: Country outlier — US is the outlier on App Total Install (+24.0% vs +7.2%).
insights.body: App Total Install · YMK: US +24.0% vs all-country +7.2% (Δ +16.9pp; ≈19% of revenue).

insights.title: Data gap — 12 slice(s) missing data — excluded from analysis.
insights.body: 12 slice(s) n/a (missing data): YAT·BR·App Total Revenue, YAT·CA·App Total New Subs, YAT·CA·App Total Revenue, YAT·DE·App Total Revenue ….

insights.title: Forecast → — App Total Revenue likely steady next period — App Total New Subs in line with upstream.
insights.body: App Total New Subs -10.5% moves with its upstream (App Total New User -6.8%, App Total Install +3.5%); no outsized App Total Revenue swing expected from the trial cohort next period.

insights.title: Lead–lag check — App Total Revenue's -1.6% isn't from acquisition — check churn / pricing / refunds.
insights.body: App Total Revenue this wk vs prior wk = -1.6% runs counter to its 7-day driver App Total New Subs prior wk vs the week before = +1.8% — App Total Revenue's move isn't explained by the prior subs cohort; look at churn, refunds, or pricing rather than acquisition.

insights.title: Funnel conversion — Conversion to New Subs splits by app — YCP softening (-11.4% vs upstream -3.6%).
insights.body: Upstream→New Subs conversion splits by app: YCP -11.4% vs upstream -3.6% (conversion softening); YCV -10.1% vs upstream +1.3% (conversion softening). (Revenue is downstream and lags ~7d — see the lead–lag check.)
